text: The listener classifies the verification result, then retrieves signature and digest names on both the failure and success paths. GetTopLevelSignerInfo checks signed structure rather than verification success, and the panel shows the names when present. The exact landing therefore does not restrict signature metadata to successfully verified signatures. Encryption metadata has a different explicit SUCCESS guard. These are source conditions; no malformed message, verification failure or live panel was exercised.
title: Signature algorithm metadata is separate from signature verification success
